```{python}
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import os
from dotenv import load_dotenv
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
import importlib
import utils.db_cleaning_utils as dbu
importlib.reload(dbu)

from utils.db_cleaning_utils import spatial_then_yoy, all_county_years, yoy_change

load_dotenv()
```

```{python}
# setup connection variables to local sql db
database_url = os.getenv("DATABASE_URL")
engine = create_engine(database_url)
```

```{python}
# Load required tables
air_df = pd.read_sql_table("air_quality", engine)
bus_df = pd.read_sql_table("business_patterns", engine)
gdp_df = pd.read_sql_table("gdp", engine)
inc_df = pd.read_sql_table("personal_income", engine)
perm_df = pd.read_sql_table("res_construction_permits", engine)
emp_df = pd.read_sql_table("unemployment", engine)
county_df = pd.read_sql_table("us_counties", engine)
dc_df = pd.read_sql_table("naics_518_establishments", engine)
```

```{python}
# Do Spatial and year over year Calculations for most tables
air_df = spatial_then_yoy(air_df, county_df)
gdp_df = spatial_then_yoy(gdp_df, county_df)
inc_df = spatial_then_yoy(inc_df, county_df)
perm_df = spatial_then_yoy(perm_df, county_df)
emp_df = spatial_then_yoy(emp_df, county_df)
bus_df = spatial_then_yoy(bus_df, county_df, key_cols = ["naics_industry_code"])
```

```{python}
# Do Spatial and yoy calculations for dc_df
county_year_df = all_county_years(county_df, year_start = 2004, year_end = 2025)
dc_df = county_year_df.merge(dc_df, on = ["county_id", "year"], how = "left")

# Aggregate first
dc_df = (
    dc_df
    .groupby(["county_id", "year"], as_index=False)
    .agg({"estabs": "sum"})
)

dc_df = spatial_then_yoy(dc_df, county_df, include_cols = ["estabs"], fill_type = "new_col", num_counties = 10, self_weight = 0.5) # Use own value as 0.5

dc_df = dc_df.sort_values(["county_id", "year"]).reset_index(drop=True)
g = dc_df.groupby("county_id", dropna = False) # Just the counties for shifting

# Use asinh because it handles negatives and 0s
dc_df["estabs_asinh"] = np.arcsinh(dc_df["estabs"])
dc_df["estabs_lag1"] = g["estabs"].shift(1)
dc_df["estabs_yoy_raw_diff"] = dc_df["estabs"] - dc_df["estabs_lag1"]
dc_df["estabs_asinh_lag1"] = g["estabs_asinh"].shift(1)
dc_df["estabs_asinh_growth"] = dc_df["estabs_asinh"] - dc_df["estabs_asinh_lag1"]

dc_df["estabs_spatial_asinh"] = np.arcsinh(dc_df["estabs_spatial_weighted_avg_10"])
dc_df["estabs_spatial_lag1"] = g["estabs_spatial_weighted_avg_10"].shift(1)
dc_df["estabs_spatial_raw_diff"] = (
    dc_df["estabs_spatial_weighted_avg_10"] - dc_df["estabs_spatial_lag1"]
)
dc_df["estabs_spatial_asinh_lag1"] = g["estabs_spatial_asinh"].shift(1)
dc_df["estabs_spatial_asinh_growth"] = (
    dc_df["estabs_spatial_asinh"] - dc_df["estabs_spatial_asinh_lag1"]
)

dc_df = dc_df.drop(columns=[
    "estabs_lag1",
    "estabs_asinh_lag1", 
    "estabs_spatial_lag1",
    "estabs_spatial_asinh_lag1",
    "estabs_yoy_change"
])
```
